certificateDefinition: 1 CBAM certificate = 1 tonne CO2e embedded emissions
defaultValuesInstrument: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 (definitive-period default values; corrected by (EU) 2026/1740)

defaultValueMarkup.note: Using default values (not verified actuals) adds a mark-up to the emissions figure: 10% (2026), 20% (2027), 30% (from 2028) for iron & steel, aluminium, cement; 1% for fertilisers.

disclaimer: Estimation and audit-trail tooling using published default values. Not legal advice. Not the official EU CBAM registry. The legally binding default values are those set out in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621; verified actual emissions require an accredited verifier.
